messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — Sev2: tool/function-calling errors observed for tenant AcmeCorp (dedicated VPC pool acme-dp-1). Alerts indicate ~100% of function calls returning 422/parse_error. Auto-escalating to eng-oncall.
ashley: seeing the same in logs. Errors started ~08:14 UTC after a customer deploy. Affected only acme-dp-1, isolated to their dedicated pool.
sam: @ashley linking traces — looks like calls to /tools/parse-json are returning HTML (their parser service). Could be schema drift from their deploy.
ashley: confirmed. Most failures are: `tool_error: parser_regression: unexpected token` and some payloads show extra trailing commas.
acme_oncall: hi team — we pushed a change to our parser at 08:11 to accept looser JSON; rolling back now. We see errors in our telemetry correlating to tool-call failures.
diego: quick triage question — do we need to page infra? Is this impacting other tenants?
ashley: limited to AcmeCorp dedicated pool (tenant isolation holding). No cross-tenant impact.
mia: good — scope confirmed. We should still treat as Sev2 since customer-facing and impacting production.
sam: mitigation options: 1) ask Acme to roll parser change back (they're doing that), 2) disable function-calling for that tenant and route to model-only responses, 3) apply a temporary permissive parser in our tool proxy (ugly).
acme_oncall: rollback started. ETA ~10 mins. But can you flip function-calling off while we stabilize? That would avoid customer-visible failures.
dashley: (typo) ashley: I can flip a tenant feature flag. Suggest we do 2) short-term and monitor.
sam: agree. Also create a routing override to send requests to a fallback model variant without tool-calls while flag is on.
ashley: executing now. Command:```bash
# disable function calling for tenant AcmeCorp via control plane
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  https://control.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/acme/flags \ 
  -d '{"disable_function_calls":true, "note":"temp mitigate parser regressions 2025-10-22"}'
```
ashley: flag set -> `disable_function_calls=true` returned. Propagating to acme-dp-1.
mia: adding routing override to fallback model and disabling tool binding in the tenant policy. Config snippet:```json
{
  "tenant": "acme",
  "route_override": "redwood/llama-3-small-fallback",
  "tool_bindings": []
}
```
sam: pushed override, new traffic starts hitting fallback in ~30s. Monitoring request success rate.
ashley: error rate dropped from 98% -> 3% after flag/route applied. Most remaining errors are timeouts (we throttled a bit).
acme_oncall: rollback finished on our side. Parser version is back to prior commit (v2.4.3). We're running smoke tests.
diego: great. Next steps: re-enable function-calls once Acme confirms smoke tests and we do a small canary traffic shift. Who will coordinate?
ashley: I will coordinate with Acme. Plan: keep flag for 30m, run sample 1000 requests via canary route with tool-calls enabled for 5% of traffic. If success -> fully reenable.
mia: please also add an acceptance test in our integration harness that runs Acme's schema testcases against our tool proxy before reenable.
sam: adding temporary alert for parser-like payloads so we catch regressions earlier: `alert: tool-parser-error-rate>5% in 5m for tenant acme`.
acme_oncall: smoke looks green on our side. Ready for canary when you are.
nashley: starting canary now. Enabling function-calls for 5% via rollout policy.```yaml
rollout:
  tenant: acme
  feature: function_calls
  percent: 5
  duration: 10m
```
ashley: canary succeeded — 0 parser errors in 10m window. Increasing to 50% for 15m.
sam: 50% looks fine, errors remain <1%. Pushing to 100% now.
diego: function-calling reenabled for AcmeCorp. Removing temporary route override.
mia: monitor for 1h and we'll create a postmortem. Key findings: root cause = customer parser deploy introduced subtle JSON formatting that our tool proxy's strict parser rejected (schema drift + regression).
nashley: logged incident in tracker: INC-2025-4873, customer impact: degraded function-calls for AcmeCorp (~3k requests failed during window), duration ~46m, mitigations: tenant feature-flag, routing fallback, canary rollback.
sam: followups assigned: 1) add tenant-level preflight schema checks (owner: eng-ml), 2) add integration test harness for customer parsers (owner: devex), 3) improve error messaging to customers when tool-call parse fails (owner: product).
acme_oncall: thanks for the fast response. We'll tighten our deploy checks too. Appreciate the rollback and canary. :thumbsup:
nashley: handing off to diego for 1h monitoring. I'm going offline. Please ping if anything spikes.
diego: ack — monitoring dashboard pinned. I'll post an update in 30m.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-4873 transitioned to "mitigated" by ashley at 2025-10-22T09:01:23Z. Postmortem scheduled for 2025-10-23 15:00 UTC.
diego: 30m update — metrics stable, no regression. Closing thread for active coordination; will follow up in postmortem.
acme_oncall: closing on our side as well. Thanks again.
